keyPoints: Shuddh padarth me sirf ek prakaar ke kan hote hain — jaise shuddh paani, loha ya oxygen; inke gun nishchit hote hain.
Mishran me do ya zyada padarth mile hote hain; hawa, samudra ka paani aur mitti mishran ke udaharan hain.
Samgun mishran (solution) me ghatak ek jaise dikhte hain — cheeni ka sharbat aur namak ka paani iske udaharan hain.
Vishamgun mishran me ghatak alag-alag dikhte hain — jaise ret aur paani ka mishran ya tel-paani ka mel.
Mishran ko bhautik vidhiyon — chhanna, fatekna, vaashpan — se alag kiya ja sakta hai, par yogik ko todne ke liye rasayanik vidhi chahiye hoti hai.
Tatva, yogik aur mishran — ye padarth ke teen varg hain; tatva sabse saral, yogik tatvon ka rasayanik mel aur mishran bhautik mel hai.
Aam galti: shuddh paani ko tatva samajhna; paani hydrogen aur oxygen ka yogik hai, tatva nahi — tatva wo hai jo aur saral na toda ja sake.
subject: Science
title: Kya Padarth Shuddh Hai
